edits.old: The deployment topology (cluster names, node pools, replica counts, resource sizes, zone spread, ingress class and the exact probe timings) belongs to each environment and is set by the platform team in its values file; the chart exposes every one of them as a value and this story fixes only their names and the rule that they are never hard-coded (GAP-0500; ASM-0692).
edits.new:
The deployment topology (cluster names, node pools, replica counts, resource sizes, zone spread, ingress class and the exact probe timings) belongs to each environment and is set by the platform team in its values file; the chart exposes every one of them as a value and this story fixes only their names and the rule that they are never hard-coded (GAP-0500; ASM-0692).

**Reference load and ACE read.** The governance rows for `sys_fields` are loaded through the P3 rwb-case reference-load contract (POST /admin/reference-loads) and applied and read back through the P1 dictionary contract; the `days_past_due` value is read by P1 from the 30 `recovery.v_ace_*` views; the ACE team lead confirmation is recorded as a role, a date and a stored document reference (ASM-B-ITG-W1-08-E1064-1 to -6).

**Reference-table read.** Every list of values, including LOV-ROLE and the refresh-cycle list, is read through GET /api/recovery/case/v1/reference-data/{tableCode} on the rwb-case base, with its fake, one hop and a 2 s timeout; no list is written as a constant in code.

**Approved governance load.** An approved governance load is applied by the service's own load path in the transaction of its approval; the state of the load is carried on the load record, and an applied migration is never edited.
